main:44.page: And You Will Know The Truth
main:44.text: And You Will Know The Truth is the forty-seventh mission in Red Dead Redemption. John Marston is denied seeing his family once again by Agent Ross. He explains that they need to "take care of Dutch Van Der Linde now", and Marston has to help. With the help of the American Army, they attack his gang and move on to Dutch's hideout.
